new.analysis:
### What happened last week
No runs were recorded Mon, Wed or Sat, yet your check-in said sleep was 7.5 hrs, stress low, body fine and you felt great. That mix is a puzzle. Tell me what got in the way, so I know whether it was travel, work, weather or something else.

### Why this week looks like Sep 14 – 20
A week off running is not a disaster, but jumping straight to longer run intervals after a gap is how new runners pick up niggles. So we repeat the 8 x 2 min run and 1 min walk shape you handled well on Sep 14 and 16, and add a little on Saturday only.

### How the race fits
The race is Sun Nov 15, so this is week one of five before a short taper. If the three runs land this week, next week we stretch the run segments to 3 minutes. Getting the sessions in, in order, matters more right now than any single run being long.

### How to run them
Keep the effort conversational, the same breathing you had in the Sep 19 run. If a run interval feels much harder than a 6/10, walk a little sooner and finish the set. No pain is the rule: niggles that build during a run mean walk home.
